ios.desc:
Reflect: Track Anything, Run Experiments, Gain Insights

Reflect is the ultimate app for tracking anything in your life, conducting self-experiments, setting goals and building habits, and gaining valuable insights from your data. Whether you want to monitor your mood, symptoms, habits, productivity, or any other aspect of your life, Reflect empowers you with unparalleled flexibility and control.


KEY FEATURES

• Track Anything: Log your mood, symptoms, sleep, diet, exercise, productivity, medication, supplements, habits, weight, blood pressure, blood sugar, menstrual cycle, and more. The possibilities are endless!
• Self-Experimentation: Test hypotheses about changes in your life and get detailed reports comparing your predictions to the actual outcomes.
• Goals: Track habits and progress towards outcomes that matter to you
• Reports: Receive weekly and monthly reports summarizing significant changes and trends in your tracked metrics.
• Powerful Visualizations: Identify patterns, correlations, and trends in your data through interactive charts, graphs, and calendars.
• Uncover Correlations: Discover which metrics are most strongly associated with your key variables.
• Seamless Integrations: Effortlessly sync data from popular health and wellness devices and platforms, including local weather, Oura Ring, WHOOP, and Apple Health, for a comprehensive and centralized tracking experience.
• Event Analysis: Pinpoint meaningful changes in your data surrounding specific events or points in time.
• Import & Export: Easily migrate your existing data or export your Reflect data at any time, ensuring full control and portability.
• Privacy: All data is stored and analyzed locally on your device, ensuring your information remains completely private and secure.


TRACK ANYTHING

Mood & Mental Health:
• Happiness, joy, sadness, anxiety, stress, depression
• Self-esteem, confidence, motivation, concentration
• Panic attacks, phobias, OCD, PTSD, ADHD, bipolar disorder, Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD)

Symptoms & Conditions:
• Headaches, chronic pain
• Fatigue, energy levels, insomnia, sleep quality, sleep duration
• Allergies, asthma, respiratory issues
• Digestion, bloating, constipation, diarrhea, acid reflux, IBS
• Autoimmune disorders, fibromyalgia, arthritis, inflammation
• Cardiovascular health, heart palpitations, blood pressure

Productivity & Performance:
• Focus, concentration, attention span, distractions, procrastination
• Motivation, discipline, willpower

I purposely did not set up any infrastructure for my iOS app Reflect and made it local-first [0]. I did it so that I could make the app completely private but it’s come with the wonderful side effect that the product is easily horizontally scalable. The only overhead I have for more users is a busier discord channel and so far that community growth has felt very rewarding.

[0] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reflect-track-anything/id6463800032

quotes.text:
Reflect is an iOS app that allows you to track any data you can think of, and then gain insights from that data -- whether it's your mood, symptoms, activities, events, performance, supplements, habits, or weight. We have a page describing the following features in more detail [1]

Major Features:

• Free unlimited custom tracking: Unlike other apps, recording your data with Reflect is completely free; you can track as much as you'd like and you are only limited by your imagination.

• Visualization: See trends in your data and identify relationships between metrics.

• Correlations: Learn which metrics correspond most highly with anything you track. Answer questions like "am I more productive on days I wake up earlier?" or "how does spending time outside affect my ability to concentrate?".

• Get started immediately: There is no "signing up" step; just specify what your data looks like and begin recording.

• Extreme privacy: All data storage and analysis are performed locally on your device.

• Extreme flexibility: Reflect lets you construct forms that are specifically tailored to your needs. There are no limitations such as tracking only once per day, or having only a few things to choose from.

• Free importing: Migrate to Reflect and import your CSV data with ease with Reflect's template builder, enabling you to reap the benefits of Reflect's visualizations and insights immediately.

• Free exporting: There is no lock-in with Reflect. You are free to leave at any time; …
